chunks: A number of our companions, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Abi Nasr, from Hisham ibn Salim, from Sa'd, from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him), who said:

We were eight men in his presence, and we mentioned Ramadan, so he said: Do not say 'This is Ramadan', nor 'Ramadan is gone', nor 'Ramadan has come', for Ramadan is a Name from the Names of God, Mighty and Majestic — it neither comes nor goes. It is only the transient thing that comes and goes. But rather say 'Month of Ramadan', for the month is annexed to the Name, and the Name is the Name of God, Mighty is His Mention, and it is the month in which the Quran was revealed — He made it a parable and a festival.

key_terms.أَسْمَاءُ اللَّهِ: The Divine Names of God — a theological concept referring to God's 99 or more attributes/names, each of which is eternal and transcends temporal change
key_terms.الزَّائِلُ: The transient/passing entity — contrasted with the eternal Divine Name; applies to the lunar month itself, not to God's name
key_terms.شَهْرُ رَمَضَانَ: Month of Ramadan — the Quranic phrasing (2:185) that the Imam insists upon as the only correct expression
key_terms.مُضَافٌ: In Arabic grammar, a noun in a genitive construct (idafa); here the 'month' is the first term of the construct and 'Ramadan' is the possessive second term

ai.seo_question: Why did Imam al-Baqir say we should say 'Month of Ramadan' rather than just 'Ramadan'?
ai.summary: Imam al-Baqir (AS) instructed a gathering of eight companions that the word 'Ramadan' alone should not be used as a subject for temporal phrases like 'Ramadan has come' or 'Ramadan has gone,' because 'Ramadan' is one of the Divine Names of God and therefore transcends time. The proper expression is 'Month of Ramadan,' where the word 'month' serves as the temporal noun and 'Ramadan' as the divine name to which it is annexed. This linguistic teaching reflects the Shia theological concern for reverence toward the Divine Names and proper Quranic language, as Quran 2:185 specifically uses 'shahr Ramadan' (Month of Ramadan).
